data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kinna total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.

in_hebrew.name: קִנָּה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew root 'k-n-n' meaning 'to bend', this name carries the meaning of 'grace' or 'beauty'. It can also imply 'affection' or 'graciousness'.

in_greek.name: Κιννα
in_greek.long_meaning: In Greek, the name Kinna may be derived from the word 'kinos', which means 'reaping'. This could refer to the idea of gathering or collecting something valuable, such as blessings or grace.

in_latin.name: Cinnah
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin form of the name Kinna is Cinnah. This name retains the original meaning of 'grace' or 'kindness', which is a common theme in Christian and biblical names.
